prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, finish copy, finish notification, sign_in hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were effective, winning in 3 of 4 tests (+9.4%, +5.6%, and +4.3%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +4.0%), while the other 5 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear positive effect was seen across 2 tests each for choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, sign_in copy, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Hide and Summon Gesture Practice Flow: Add an interactive practice component on home_intro where users test double-clicking and key shortcuts to hide and summon their pet on desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet after setup, and interactive finish flows show strong historic conversion gains (+9.4%, +5.6%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Diagnostics Info: Provide real-time audio and rendering stage visual diagnostic indicators on the waiting screen to clarify background pet assembly. (why: Home step median duration is 201s with a high mean of 2336s, and previous wait_info changes delivered positive conversion boosts (+4.2%).)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Compact Companion Path Choice Screen Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a compact dual-column layout clearly contrasting pre-made vs custom pets. (why: choose_path loses 19.1% of users with an elevated mean time of 514s, indicating initial path selection hesitation.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Storage Persistence Hint: Display explicit visual guidance on sign_in explaining that signing in securely links and preserves your pet profile. (why: 8 support emails (the largest single theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Companion Desktop Visibility and Tray Docking Guide Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen new_tray_docking_guide illustrating how the pet docks in the system tray and how to bring it forward. (why: Support received multiple complaints about pets not showing up on desktop or users being unable to find/control pets post-setup.)
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Copy Update: Update the headline and body on adoption_certificate to reassure users that pet creation is proceeding smoothly. (why: The adoption step has the lowest step retention in the funnel (65.8%) with a median duration of 89s.)
6: [home, hint] Background Rendering Desktop Activity Hint: Display a status hint on the waiting screen reassuring users that background pet rendering continues even when minimized. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s) and 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show or app stalling.)
7: [finish, redesign] Finish Screen Spotlight Desktop Launch Layout: Redesign home_intro into a clean spotlight layout emphasizing immediate desktop pet launch readiness. (why: Finish step mean duration is very high (5815s) and overall onboarding completion is only 30.4%.)

scores.note: Interactive finish flows historically perform strongly (+4.8% avg), supported by 3 user tickets and funnel dropoff.
Home step has low dropoff but very long duration; wait_info changes showed positive gains in past tests.
Target step loses 19.1%, but overall redesigns in onboarding have consistently underperformed or hurt retention.
Strongest evidence from 8 support emails on sign_in profile persistence; low cost hint implementation.
Addresses support complaints, but adding new screens in finish step has shown negative historic returns (-1.0%).
Adoption loses the most users (34.2%), though copy changes have limited historical evidence (+0.6%).
Addresses long home wait duration and 3 support tickets, but hint changes have mixed historic confidence.
Targets high finish duration, but full screen layout redesigns generally fail to deliver positive lift.
